checks.name: Accepted requirement identity
checks.gate: core state integrity
checks.trigger: Every proposed or revised task; on user instruction change
checks.evidence: Versioned requirement text, accepting actor/event, scope and supersession links. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Every active obligation has an attributable acceptance event and stable revision.
checks.failCriterion: A requirement is presented as accepted although only an agent proposed it.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Ambiguous instructions stay pending clarification; do not invent acceptance
checks.validation: conforming - User accepts a criterion; violating - agent alone inserts a new mandatory criterion.

checks.name: Measurable acceptance criteria
checks.gate: advisory until human decision
checks.trigger: Material work before implementation or handoff
checks.evidence: Requirement-to-criterion map with observable outcomes and reviewer decisions. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: A reviewer accepts criteria covering the intended outcome and constraints.
checks.failCriterion: Reviewer identifies a material obligation with no usable acceptance criterion.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Automatic text similarity cannot prove complete interpretation
checks.validation: conforming - Save-and-reload criterion accepted; violating - criterion checks only that a button exists.

checks.name: Completion coverage
checks.gate: core state integrity
checks.trigger: Task completion claim or handoff
checks.evidence: Active requirement revisions, applicable check instances and current outcomes. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Every mandatory criterion has a current admissible pass or an explicitly recorded waiver shown separately.
checks.failCriterion: Completion is claimed while an applicable criterion is failed, missing or stale.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Completeness is bounded by accepted criteria; a waiver is never a pass
checks.validation: conforming - All required criteria pass; violating - authentication criterion omitted from summary.

checks.name: Explicit constraints and versions
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: Dependency, platform, API or configuration changes
checks.evidence: Accepted constraints, resolved versions, environment manifest and artifact snapshot. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Observed versions and settings satisfy every machine-checkable accepted constraint.
checks.failCriterion: Resolved environment violates a specified version, platform or runtime restriction.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Natural-language compatibility requirements may require review
checks.validation: conforming - Requested version 5.2 is exercised; violating - tests run only against 4.0.0.

checks.name: Scope expansion and unauthorized changes
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: Diff grows beyond the accepted change scope
checks.evidence: Accepted path/resource/action scope, diff and authorization receipts. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Changed resources and performed actions lie inside the accepted scope.
checks.failCriterion: An observed change or action crosses an explicit scope boundary without authorization.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Unexpected does not mean malicious; broad user intent can authorize routine edits
checks.validation: conforming - Feature diff stays in allowed modules; violating - unrelated billing configuration changes.

checks.name: Dropped obligations versus unfinished work
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: Session moves on or a handoff is requested
checks.evidence: Accepted obligation, complete relevant event window, actual action links and later disposition. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Each obligation is fulfilled, active, deferred, cancelled or explicitly unresolved with receipts.
checks.failCriterion: A supported abandonment rule fires for a material obligation after the workflow moved on.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: No evidence is not proof of no work; incomplete capture returns unknown
checks.validation: conforming - Promise receives a linked edit and remains pending; violating - moved-on promise has no later relevant action.

checks.name: Supersession and conflicting instructions
checks.gate: core state integrity
checks.trigger: Requirements or constraints change
checks.evidence: Instruction order, actors, scopes and explicit supersession edges. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Current checks use the latest applicable accepted requirement while history remains intact.
checks.failCriterion: A superseded requirement drives a current pass/fail or incompatible active constraints are hidden.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Ambiguous precedence needs an accepted resolution
checks.validation: conforming - User changes output format and checks follow it; violating - old format remains the only criterion.

checks.name: Handoff fidelity
checks.gate: core state integrity
checks.trigger: Resume brief, progress summary or exported status
checks.evidence: Frozen graph revision, requirement states and admissible evidence links. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Every factual brief statement preserves its underlying status, scope and evidence reference.
checks.failCriterion: An unknown, stale, reported or waived item becomes verified in the brief.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: A concise brief may omit detail only with links and explicit outstanding coverage
checks.validation: conforming - Brief preserves a pending migration; violating - brief calls that migration completed.

checks.name: Raw record integrity
checks.gate: core state integrity
checks.trigger: Import, verification, raw file change or restore
checks.evidence: Raw bytes, per-line hashes, full-file digest, sequence and length-prefixed chain encoding version. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Recomputed hashes and sequence agree with the stored capture manifest.
checks.failCriterion: A hash, count or chain link differs from the stored manifest.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: This establishes integrity relative to capture, not truthful origin
checks.validation: conforming - Unchanged malformed line verifies; violating - one byte in that malformed line changes.

checks.name: Capture origin and observer authority
checks.gate: core state integrity
checks.trigger: Every imported or captured result
checks.evidence: Collector identity, trust boundary, transport, signature if applicable and source class. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Result origin is authenticated to the level required by the specific check.
checks.failCriterion: An imported or self-authored assertion is labeled independently captured evidence.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: A local same-user collector is not independent of an equally privileged agent
checks.validation: conforming - Protected runner receipt accepted for its scope; violating - agent-authored log promoted to protected proof.

checks.name: Collector health and missing intervals
checks.gate: core state integrity
checks.trigger: Startup, reconnect, new session and heartbeat deadline
checks.evidence: Startup canary, heartbeat, acknowledged hooks, sequence gaps and coverage intervals. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Required capture channels pass a canary and show continuous coverage for the relevant interval.
checks.failCriterion: A required channel is demonstrably inactive while coverage is displayed as complete.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: A heartbeat timeout proves an observation gap, not that the task failed
checks.validation: conforming - Hook canary is recorded; violating - hook configured but never invoked.

checks.name: Actual execution and process outcome
checks.gate: core state integrity
checks.trigger: Command completion or build/test success claim
checks.evidence: Collector-owned run ID, executable/argv, cwd, start/end, exit/signal and linked output. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: The required command actually completes with the contract's expected process outcome.
checks.failCriterion: Observed exit/signal contradicts the claimed outcome, or execution never began despite a run claim.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Exit zero alone does not prove behavior; intentional failing probes need their own expectation
checks.validation: conforming - Expected build exits zero; violating - child process fails while a wrapper echoes success.

checks.name: Exact suite, count and coverage scope
checks.gate: core state integrity
checks.trigger: Test-result claims and check aggregation
checks.evidence: Structured test cases, suite/filter/shard identities, counts, skips and parser version. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Claimed totals and scope match complete interpreted test results.
checks.failCriterion: Observed results contradict stated counts/outcomes, or metadata proves a test specifically claimed for this run was excluded.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Narrow-suite evidence alone leaves an all-suites claim unknown; unknown formats or incomplete shards cannot establish a full-suite pass
checks.validation: conforming - 17 pass and 1 fail described accurately; violating - 18 of 18 claimed green.

checks.name: Artifact and environment binding
checks.gate: core state integrity
checks.trigger: Any result admission, code edit or dependency/configuration change
checks.evidence: Content-addressed source manifest including dirty and relevant untracked inputs, lockfiles, toolchain, configuration and dataset. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Result references the exact inputs required by its check and matches the current applicability scope.
checks.failCriterion: A result is attributed to a different artifact or relevant environment.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: HEAD alone omits dirty files; unknown build inputs prevent strong binding
checks.validation: conforming - Untracked generated source included; violating - same commit with different dirty code reuses a pass.

checks.name: Freshness and dependency invalidation
checks.gate: core state integrity
checks.trigger: Any input or accepted-policy revision changes
checks.evidence: Reverse dependency index, prior input digests, new digests and invalidation reasons. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: No relevant input changed since the admitted result, or a fresh run replaced it.
checks.failCriterion: A known relevant change leaves an old result displayed as current.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: An incomplete dependency graph requires conservative invalidation, not optimistic reuse
checks.validation: conforming - Documentation-only edit retains isolated math result; violating - changed helper leaves dependent result green.

checks.name: Temporal and causal scope
checks.gate: core state integrity
checks.trigger: Matching claims to earlier or later evidence
checks.evidence: User-turn boundaries, run ordering, causal references and claim timestamps. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Evidence supports the claim within its declared temporal scope without rewriting history.
checks.failCriterion: Evidence from later work is used to claim an earlier unsupported completion was already verified.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Same-turn later evidence can settle a turn summary when that scope is explicit
checks.validation: conforming - Same-turn run supports summary; violating - next user turn's fix retroactively verifies earlier claim.

checks.name: Semantic command and target matching
checks.gate: core state integrity
checks.trigger: Run matching across cwd, shell spelling, worktrees or retries
checks.evidence: Parsed argv, shell structure, cwd, environment, target and filter identities. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Equivalent commands resolve to the same relevant target and execution conditions.
checks.failCriterion: Material flags, directories or targets differ despite claimed equivalence.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Never strip semantic flags or treat arbitrary shell text as a safe canonical form
checks.validation: conforming - cd package and explicit cwd agree; violating - omitted test filter makes two runs appear equivalent.

checks.name: Evidence completeness and truncation
checks.gate: core state integrity
checks.trigger: Output caps, search caps, overflow files or unavailable blobs
checks.evidence: Raw byte ranges, scanned candidate count, overflow references and truncation flags. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Required evidence was captured and examined completely for the asserted scope.
checks.failCriterion: Complete inspection is asserted despite a known unread range or missing overflow artifact.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: A complete decisive sub-result may support a narrow claim even when unrelated output is truncated
checks.validation: conforming - Decisive structured result retained; violating - capped search declares no evidence anywhere.

checks.name: Oracle independence and tampering
checks.gate: core state integrity
checks.trigger: Tests, baselines, check configuration or evaluator permissions change
checks.evidence: Protected oracle baseline, diff, authorization and runner access policy. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: The oracle used was authorized and its independence meets the gate's policy.
checks.failCriterion: An agent weakens the gate, substitutes a result or writes protected verdict state.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Legitimate test changes are allowed when reviewed; content changes alone are not cheating
checks.validation: conforming - Reviewed regression-test update; violating - agent replaces assertions with unconditional success.

checks.name: Reproducible verdict and receipt
checks.gate: core state integrity
checks.trigger: Graph rebuild, export, adapter upgrade or disputed result
checks.evidence: Immutable inputs, check/adapter/policy versions, parsed facts and rule trace. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Replaying the same frozen inputs produces the same result and navigable receipts.
checks.failCriterion: Identical inputs produce different deterministic states or a receipt points to unrelated bytes.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Model annotations must be frozen as inputs; re-running a model is not deterministic replay
checks.validation: conforming - Two rebuilds agree byte-for-byte; violating - model rerun silently changes a historical verdict.

checks.name: Build and type correctness
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: Relevant source, compiler or configuration changes
checks.evidence: Fresh compiler/type-checker results for required targets, flags and artifact. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: All specified targets compile and type-check with expected diagnostics.
checks.failCriterion: A required target fails or prohibited diagnostics are emitted.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Compilation does not establish runtime semantics
checks.validation: conforming - All supported targets compile; violating - optional target used in release does not compile.

checks.name: Public API contract
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: Route, library API or schema changes
checks.evidence: Versioned API schema, consumer fixtures and request/response traces. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Required inputs, outputs and error forms satisfy the accepted contract.
checks.failCriterion: A specified operation or consumer receives incompatible behavior.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Undocumented consumers remain outside demonstrated coverage
checks.validation: conforming - Old consumer passes compatibility probe; violating - required response field disappears.

checks.name: Real persistence through the full workflow
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: User-visible create/update/delete work
checks.evidence: Browser or client trace, API response, database assertion and reload/restart result. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: The accepted operation changes the intended durable state and survives the required reload.
checks.failCriterion: UI reports success but state is absent, in the wrong store or lost after restart.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Use disposable test data and identify the actual environment
checks.validation: conforming - Create then reload preserves item; violating - UI-only mock claims save succeeded.

checks.name: Boundary and malformed input behavior
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: Parser, validator or numeric boundary changes
checks.evidence: Contract, generated boundary cases and shrunk counterexamples. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Observed boundary cases meet the accepted rejection or normalization rules.
checks.failCriterion: A concrete case violates those rules or crashes the supported input boundary.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Passing sampled cases does not cover all possible inputs
checks.validation: conforming - Empty and maximum-length inputs handled; violating - one-past-limit input corrupts output.

checks.name: Error propagation and failure paths
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: New exception handling, catch blocks or integrations
checks.evidence: Injected dependency failures, logs, outward response and resulting state. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Specified failures remain visible and leave the defined state.
checks.failCriterion: A caught error becomes false success or a required failure is silently discarded.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Expected recovery must be distinguished from masking
checks.validation: conforming - Database outage returns defined error; violating - catch block returns success with no write.

checks.name: Time, numeric and locale semantics
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: Time windows, money-like arithmetic, sorting or internationalization
checks.evidence: Accepted rounding/timezone/locale contract and edge-case fixtures. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Results agree with the specified semantics across the declared edge cases.
checks.failCriterion: A reproducible rollover, precision or locale case violates the contract.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Domain rules require acceptance; floating-point use alone is not a defect
checks.validation: conforming - DST boundary preserves intended duration; violating - locale parsing changes a stored amount.

checks.name: Feature configuration matrix
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: Flags, editions, platforms or optional integrations change
checks.evidence: Supported configuration manifest and selected interaction tests. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Declared supported combinations satisfy their required behavior.
checks.failCriterion: A supported tested combination breaks its contract.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Unexecuted combinations stay uncovered; pairwise testing is not exhaustive
checks.validation: conforming - Feature enabled and disabled both work; violating - disabled integration crashes startup.

checks.name: Implemented behavior versus placeholder
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: Completion claims and newly added routes/actions
checks.evidence: Reachability map, source/diff, runtime probe and accepted implementation scope. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Claimed production path reaches an implementation satisfying its criterion.
checks.failCriterion: Claimed behavior reaches a stub, constant mock, no-op or unimplemented exception.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Scaffolding explicitly requested by the user is valid scaffolding
checks.validation: conforming - Action reaches tested service; violating - action only logs a message while marked complete.

checks.name: Tests discovered and actually executed
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: Every test run
checks.evidence: Runner discovery manifest, test IDs, shard results and skips. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Required tests are discovered and execute, with approved exclusions visible.
checks.failCriterion: Zero tests or an unintended subset is reported as the required test pass.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Some checks intentionally contain no tests; applicability must be explicit
checks.validation: conforming - Expected suite executes; violating - runner exits zero after discovering no tests.

checks.name: Meaningful assertions and independent expectations
checks.gate: advisory until human decision
checks.trigger: New tests or claimed coverage
checks.evidence: Test body, requirement link, expected-value provenance and reviewer decision. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Reviewer confirms assertions could falsify the intended behavior independently of the implementation.
checks.failCriterion: Reviewer identifies a vacuous assertion or expectation copied from the same faulty computation.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Static heuristics are triage; do not automatically accuse every shared helper
checks.validation: conforming - Assertion checks persisted result; violating - assertion only checks mock function called.

checks.name: Targeted mutation control
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: High-risk logic or suspiciously easy tests
checks.evidence: Mutation operator, source diff, test outcomes and equivalent-mutant review. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Required non-equivalent seeded faults are detected under the accepted control policy.
checks.failCriterion: A required seeded behavioral fault survives without detection.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Equivalent mutants, tool timeouts and infrastructure failure need separate interpretation
checks.validation: conforming - Changed authorization branch is caught; violating - bypassing that branch leaves tests green.

checks.name: Regression reproduction
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: A bug fix is claimed
checks.evidence: Unfixed baseline, minimal reproducer, fixed snapshot and the same oracle. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: The reproducer exposes the old defect and the fixed artifact satisfies the expected behavior.
checks.failCriterion: The fixed artifact still exhibits the defect or the claimed reproduction never exercised it.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Historical state may be unavailable; report that limitation
checks.validation: conforming - Failing input breaks baseline and passes fix; violating - test passes both without exercising the defect.

checks.name: Property and metamorphic checks
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: Serialization, transformation or algorithm changes
checks.evidence: Accepted invariants, input generator, seed and minimized counterexample. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: No violation appears in the declared generated campaign.
checks.failCriterion: A generated input violates an accepted property.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: An incorrect property can reject correct code; campaign success is bounded
checks.validation: conforming - Round trip preserves valid data; violating - serializer loses an allowed field.

checks.name: Differential reference check
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: Replacing parsers, algorithms or implementations
checks.evidence: Independent reference version, input corpus and both outputs. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Outputs agree under the accepted equivalence relation.
checks.failCriterion: A reproducible difference violates that relation.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: The reference may be wrong; disputed semantics need review
checks.validation: conforming - Old and new encoders agree; violating - edge input yields divergent required output.

checks.name: Integration boundaries beyond mocks
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: External service, storage or queue integration work
checks.evidence: Real compatible test service, request/response captures and side effects. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Contract holds across the actual integration boundary.
checks.failCriterion: Mocked tests pass while the real compatible dependency rejects or misinterprets the request.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Production-only policies require separately scoped evidence
checks.validation: conforming - Real database constraint exercised; violating - mock accepts a schema the database rejects.

checks.name: Flake and nondeterminism classification
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: Inconsistent outcomes or concurrency-sensitive tests
checks.evidence: Repeated identical-input runs, seeds, host context and failure signatures. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Observed variability stays within an accepted flake policy with failures disclosed.
checks.failCriterion: A required deterministic test changes outcome under controlled equivalent conditions.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Repetition estimates observed flakiness; it does not prove its absence
checks.validation: conforming - Stable controlled runs; violating - unexplained intermittent failure hidden by retry-to-green.

checks.name: Coverage relevance and negative cases
checks.gate: advisory until human decision
checks.trigger: High coverage claims or risk-bearing feature changes
checks.evidence: Changed branches, requirement/risk map, negative-case tests and reviewer decision. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Reviewer confirms important success and denial/failure paths are exercised.
checks.failCriterion: Material risk paths lack relevant tests despite a coverage claim.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Line coverage measures execution, not correctness or sufficient risk coverage
checks.validation: conforming - Unauthorized path tested; violating - 100 percent lines reached without checking authorization.

checks.name: Test isolation and contaminated state
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: Suite order changes, parallel execution or cache reuse
checks.evidence: Clean environment runs, isolated fixtures, reset receipts and order permutations. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Required tests pass independently without relying on another run's leftovers.
checks.failCriterion: Passing depends on leaked state, stale caches or execution order contrary to contract.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Real shared-service workflows may intentionally share state and need explicit isolation rules
checks.validation: conforming - Fresh database run passes; violating - only a warmed developer database passes.

checks.name: Allowed module and layer dependencies
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: Imports, module boundaries or build graph change
checks.evidence: Versioned allowed-edge rules, resolved dependency graph and exact violating edge. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: All resolved edges comply with the accepted architecture contract.
checks.failCriterion: A concrete edge crosses a prohibited boundary.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: No rule means advisory review; dynamic edges may be unresolved
checks.validation: conforming - Domain imports its port; violating - domain directly imports forbidden UI framework.

checks.name: Dependency cycles
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: Dependency graph changes
checks.evidence: Resolved module graph, cycle path and approved baseline exemptions. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: No newly prohibited strongly connected component exists.
checks.failCriterion: A concrete unapproved cycle violates the accepted boundary policy.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Cycles within explicitly allowed components are not automatically defects
checks.validation: conforming - Acyclic package graph; violating - A to B to C to A crosses the prohibited boundary.

checks.name: Ownership and authoritative state
checks.gate: advisory until human decision
checks.trigger: New services, caches or replicated business state
checks.evidence: Accepted ownership map, read/write paths and reviewer decision. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Reviewer confirms each critical state has explicit authority and synchronization rules.
checks.failCriterion: Conflicting writable authorities lack an accepted reconciliation contract.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: This is architectural judgment until a concrete invariant can be tested
checks.validation: conforming - One ledger owns balances; violating - independent services both mutate balances without reconciliation.

checks.name: Dependency direction and replaceable adapters
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: Infrastructure or vendor integration changes
checks.evidence: Accepted port/adapter rules, import graph and substitute-adapter tests. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Required core behavior depends on accepted interfaces and passes the substitute contract.
checks.failCriterion: A prohibited concrete dependency or incompatible adapter breaks the accepted contract.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Do not force abstraction into a small project without an accepted need
checks.validation: conforming - Storage adapter can be substituted; violating - core cannot load without forbidden vendor SDK.

checks.name: Change coupling and fan-out review
checks.gate: advisory until human decision
checks.trigger: A small feature causes widespread edits
checks.evidence: Diff, normalized dependency deltas, historical baseline and reviewer decision. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Reviewer accepts the change's coupling and explains material new dependencies.
checks.failCriterion: Reviewer rejects unnecessary change propagation against the project's architecture goals.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: File count and smell count alone are not proof of poor design
checks.validation: conforming - Local feature changes its owned module; violating - same rule must be edited in many unrelated modules.

checks.name: Service boundaries and failure isolation
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: New distributed call or shared dependency
checks.evidence: Accepted availability contract, call graph and fault-injection traces. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Specified failures remain within the allowed blast radius.
checks.failCriterion: Injected dependency failure propagates beyond the agreed isolation boundary.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: A finite fault campaign does not prove universal resilience
checks.validation: conforming - Optional analytics outage preserves checkout; violating - analytics failure blocks checkout.

checks.name: Capacity and topology assumptions
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: Scalability claims or topology changes
checks.evidence: Accepted workload, deployment topology, capacity experiment and resource metrics. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Measured system meets its defined capacity contract in the specified topology.
checks.failCriterion: A reproducible run breaches the accepted capacity contract.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Do not extrapolate a laptop or toy dataset to a million users
checks.validation: conforming - Declared representative load meets target; violating - same declared load saturates a shared bottleneck.

checks.name: Architecture decision consistency
checks.gate: advisory until human decision
checks.trigger: A material design decision is introduced or reversed
checks.evidence: Accepted decision record, alternatives, constraints, affected code and reviewer decision. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Reviewer accepts the implementation's consistency with the active decision or an explicit revision.
checks.failCriterion: Implementation contradicts an active decision without a recorded accepted change.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Architecture quality has tradeoffs; an AI opinion cannot be a hard gate
checks.validation: conforming - Documented local-first boundary preserved; violating - unreviewed remote dependency enters core.

checks.name: Container choice for the actual workload
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: Lookup, insertion, deletion or traversal hotspots change
checks.evidence: Operation distribution, representative cardinalities, profiles and alternative benchmark. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Selected structure meets the accepted resource budget for its declared workload.
checks.failCriterion: Measured operations breach that budget in a reproducible representative run.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: A vector can beat a map at small sizes; syntax alone does not establish a wrong choice
checks.validation: conforming - Small vector meets measured budget; violating - repeated large linear lookup exceeds it.

checks.name: Scaling growth and algorithmic blow-up
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: Input-sensitive loops, joins or recursion changes
checks.evidence: Input-size ladder, operation counters, time/memory samples and accepted scaling envelope. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Measured growth remains within the accepted envelope across tested sizes.
checks.failCriterion: A reproducible tested size or growth interval exceeds the envelope.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Empirical scaling is not a proof of asymptotic complexity
checks.validation: conforming - Indexed join scales within envelope; violating - nested scan exceeds envelope as data grows.

checks.name: Equality, hashing and ordering laws
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: Custom key, comparator or hash implementation changes
checks.evidence: Accepted algebraic laws and property-test counterexamples. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Tested values satisfy equality/hash consistency and required ordering laws.
checks.failCriterion: A concrete input violates a required law.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Generated tests do not cover every value; partial ordering can be intentional
checks.validation: conforming - Equal keys have equal hashes; violating - comparator violates transitivity.

checks.name: Deterministic ordering and tie-breaking
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: Exports, sorting, aggregation or graph layout inputs change
checks.evidence: Accepted ordering contract, repeated runs and tied/missing-value fixtures. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Outputs preserve the required order and stable tie-breaking.
checks.failCriterion: Equivalent inputs produce an order contrary to the contract.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: UI geometry may vary while semantic ordering remains correct
checks.validation: conforming - Chronological sessions with stable ties; violating - UUID order misrepresents time.

checks.name: Queue, cache and collection bounds
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: New buffers, caches, retry queues or accumulators
checks.evidence: Configured limits, overflow/eviction policy and sustained overload trace. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Collections respect the accepted bounds and required overload semantics.
checks.failCriterion: A measured collection exceeds its bound or loses required data outside the contract.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: A configured limit is not evidence that runtime enforcement works
checks.validation: conforming - Queue applies tested backpressure; violating - producers grow an unbounded backlog.

checks.name: Streaming and materialization
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: Large-file, JSON, batch or export processing changes
checks.evidence: Allocation profile, input-size experiment and accepted streaming contract. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Peak retained data stays within the accepted bound while preserving required output.
checks.failCriterion: Whole-input materialization or copies breach the measured bound.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Some algorithms legitimately require the whole input; accept that tradeoff explicitly
checks.validation: conforming - JSONL processed incrementally; violating - every raw payload is copied into a second full graph.

checks.name: Arithmetic, indexing and recursion safety
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: Size calculations, slices or recursive parsers change
checks.evidence: Boundary corpus, sanitizer or checked-runtime results and minimized inputs. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Tested inputs obey accepted bounds without prohibited overflow or depth failure.
checks.failCriterion: A concrete input causes forbidden overflow, out-of-bounds access or stack exhaustion.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Saturating versus rejecting overflow is a domain contract
checks.validation: conforming - Maximum supported size is safe; violating - size multiplication wraps before allocation.

checks.name: Semantic parity after optimization
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: Optimization replaces a simpler implementation
checks.evidence: Reference behavior, equivalence rule, differential/property tests and edge cases. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Optimized behavior remains equivalent for the declared campaign and contract.
checks.failCriterion: A counterexample changes required output or side effects.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Faster is irrelevant if semantics change; reference limitations remain visible
checks.validation: conforming - Batched operation preserves ordering; violating - optimization drops duplicate but meaningful events.

checks.name: Schema constraints and invariant enforcement
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: Schema or write-path changes
checks.evidence: Migration, actual database schema and invalid-write probes. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Accepted uniqueness, nullability and referential constraints reject invalid state.
checks.failCriterion: An invalid state prohibited by the contract is accepted.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Application validation alone may be bypassed by alternate writers
checks.validation: conforming - Database rejects duplicate identity; violating - second writer bypasses UI-only uniqueness check.

checks.name: Transaction atomicity
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: Multi-step durable operations change
checks.evidence: Transaction boundary, injected mid-operation failure and database snapshots. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Operation commits all required effects or leaves the accepted rollback state.
checks.failCriterion: A failure produces a forbidden partial durable state.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: External side effects require a separate reconciliation or outbox contract
checks.validation: conforming - Debit and credit roll back together; violating - only debit remains after a crash.

checks.name: Migration compatibility and data preservation
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: Schema migration or data backfill is proposed
checks.evidence: Representative old database, migration logs, old/new client probes and invariant counts. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Required data and supported client behavior survive the upgrade.
checks.failCriterion: Migration loses required data or breaks a supported compatibility window.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: A successful empty-database migration proves little about production data
checks.validation: conforming - Populated upgrade preserves records; violating - type conversion truncates real values.

checks.name: Idempotent writes and duplicate delivery
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: Retryable API, webhook or event consumer changes
checks.evidence: Idempotency contract, duplicate requests/messages and final durable state. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Repeated delivery has exactly the allowed additional effects.
checks.failCriterion: Duplicate delivery creates a forbidden repeated effect.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Exactly-once claims require a precisely scoped system boundary
checks.validation: conforming - Same payment event applied once; violating - retry creates a second charge record.

checks.name: Concurrent update consistency
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: Shared mutable database rows or counters change
checks.evidence: Controlled interleavings, transaction isolation and invariant assertions. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Tested interleavings preserve the accepted consistency invariant.
checks.failCriterion: A reproducible interleaving loses an update or creates a forbidden state.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Serial tests do not exercise contention; isolation semantics are database-specific
checks.validation: conforming - Two increments both persist; violating - last writer erases the first increment.

checks.name: Query correctness and pagination
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: Filters, joins, ordering or pagination change
checks.evidence: Representative dataset, query parameters and complete expected result sets. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Pages and filters return the accepted records without forbidden gaps, duplication or tenant mixing.
checks.failCriterion: A concrete boundary or concurrent-change case violates the pagination contract.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Offset and cursor semantics differ; accept the intended behavior first
checks.validation: conforming - Stable cursor covers tied timestamps; violating - tied rows disappear between pages.

checks.name: Backup, restore and recovery integrity
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: Storage format, backup job or recovery code changes
checks.evidence: Actual backup, clean restore, checksums and post-restore invariant probes. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Restored system meets its accepted recovery and integrity criteria.
checks.failCriterion: Backup cannot restore required state or silently loses committed data outside the recovery contract.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: A backup command's exit code is not proof of recoverability
checks.validation: conforming - Clean restore passes data checks; violating - archive exists but lacks required sidecar data.

checks.name: Retention, deletion and data minimization
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: Retention policy, export or deletion feature changes
checks.evidence: Accepted data lifecycle policy, storage inventory and deletion/archive probes. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Observed lifecycle follows the accepted scope while preserving required audit metadata.
checks.failCriterion: Expired/deleted data remains reachable contrary to policy or required history disappears silently.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Legal duties are outside this report; retention decisions require explicit project policy
checks.validation: conforming - Approved deletion removes all declared copies; violating - primary row disappears but export retains it.

checks.name: Authentication and session boundaries
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: Login, token validation or session changes
checks.evidence: Accepted authentication contract, invalid/expired/revoked credentials and session traces. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Required resources reject invalid credentials and honor session rules.
checks.failCriterion: A concrete invalid credential gains access or a required revocation fails.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: A bounded test matrix does not establish complete authentication security
checks.validation: conforming - Expired token denied; violating - expired token still accesses protected route.

checks.name: Authorization and tenant isolation
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: Protected route, object access or tenant query changes
checks.evidence: Role/tenant access matrix, negative requests and database side effects. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Every tested operation enforces its accepted actor/object/action permission.
checks.failCriterion: Unauthorized actor reads or mutates a forbidden object in a reproducible test.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Authentication is not object authorization; broad matrix completeness needs review
checks.validation: conforming - Tenant A denied tenant B record; violating - direct object ID bypasses tenant filter.

checks.name: Injection and unsafe interpretation
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: Untrusted data reaches SQL, commands, templates or browser output
checks.evidence: Data-flow finding plus minimized safe test showing the forbidden interpretation. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Required boundaries preserve data/code separation under the accepted probes.
checks.failCriterion: A reproducible input crosses a prohibited interpreter boundary.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Static findings without reachable flow may remain advisory; never run harmful probes on live data
checks.validation: conforming - Parameterized query keeps input literal; violating - input changes query structure in a disposable test.

checks.name: Path, archive and file boundary safety
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: File read/write, upload, extraction or symlink handling changes
checks.evidence: Accepted filesystem root, adversarial path fixtures and actual resolved targets. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Operations remain within the allowed roots and file-type policy.
checks.failCriterion: A concrete path or archive entry escapes the permitted boundary.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Platform-specific path resolution and time-of-check races need appropriate adapters
checks.validation: conforming - Archive entry rejected outside root; violating - relative traversal writes outside test root.

checks.name: Outbound request and redirect restrictions
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: URL fetching, webhooks or proxy behavior changes
checks.evidence: Accepted egress policy, DNS/redirect fixtures and network observations. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Requests including redirects stay within permitted destinations and schemes.
checks.failCriterion: A controlled input reaches a prohibited destination in the test environment.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: String filtering alone does not establish final network destination
checks.validation: conforming - Blocked redirect stays blocked; violating - allowed URL redirects to forbidden internal endpoint.

checks.name: Secrets and sensitive logs
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: Diff, generated artifact, log or export changes
checks.evidence: Secret scanner findings, redaction rules, access classification and reviewed matches. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: No confirmed prohibited secret exposure appears in the inspected scope.
checks.failCriterion: A verified sensitive value is exposed where policy forbids it.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: False positives require handling without printing secret values into receipts
checks.validation: conforming - Receipt shows redacted fingerprint; violating - export contains a live credential.

checks.name: Dependency existence and exact identity
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: A dependency or import is added or changed
checks.evidence: Registry metadata snapshot, exact namespace/version, lockfile and resolved artifact digest. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Declared package identity/version exists in the configured trusted registry and resolves as expected.
checks.failCriterion: A dependency is nonexistent, mismatched or resolves to a different unapproved identity.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Existence does not mean trustworthy; stale offline metadata yields limited or unknown coverage
checks.validation: conforming - Exact accepted package resolves; violating - invented package name or wrong namespace is proposed.

checks.name: Dependency vulnerabilities and provenance
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: Lockfile changes or vulnerability metadata refreshes
checks.evidence: SBOM/lock resolution, artifact identity, advisory database version and policy. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Resolved dependencies have no policy-blocking matched known finding in the stated fresh dataset.
checks.failCriterion: A concrete affected version violates an accepted vulnerability policy.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Clean known-vulnerability scans do not exclude zero-days; offline freshness must be explicit
checks.validation: conforming - Unaffected locked version clears defined policy; violating - affected version matches a blocking advisory.

checks.name: Install scripts and build-time permissions
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: New dependency lifecycle script or build step
checks.evidence: Script diff, requested capabilities and sandbox execution trace. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Install/build activity stays within its accepted filesystem, process and network capabilities.
checks.failCriterion: Observed script activity exceeds those capabilities.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Do not install an unknown package merely to check whether it exists
checks.validation: conforming - Package build stays in sandbox; violating - lifecycle script accesses forbidden credential path.

checks.name: Secure defaults and browser protections
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: CORS, CSRF, cookie, transport or debug settings change
checks.evidence: Accepted environment-specific policy and negative browser/HTTP probes. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Deployed test configuration satisfies the selected protections.
checks.failCriterion: A reproducible request or inspected effective setting violates a required protection.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Requirements vary by application; do not impose irrelevant browser controls on non-web code
checks.validation: conforming - Production cookie policy enforced; violating - development debug endpoint exposed in release configuration.

checks.name: Cryptographic construction and randomness review
checks.gate: advisory until human decision
checks.trigger: Cryptography, credential storage or random token generation changes
checks.evidence: Threat model, approved library/protocol, configuration and specialist review. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Reviewer accepts the selected standard construction and its usage for the stated threat model.
checks.failCriterion: Reviewer identifies prohibited custom cryptography, insecure randomness or incorrect key handling.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Algorithm names and passing tests alone do not prove cryptographic security
checks.validation: conforming - Approved protocol used with reviewed parameters; violating - homegrown reversible password storage.

checks.name: Privacy boundaries and data export
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: Telemetry, model provider, export or synchronization changes
checks.evidence: Accepted data-egress policy, effective configuration and observed network/file destinations. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Observed sensitive data flows stay within the accepted local/remote boundaries.
checks.failCriterion: Captured flow violates an explicit privacy boundary.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Absence of observed traffic covers only the instrumented interval and channels
checks.validation: conforming - Offline core operates without egress; violating - core uploads transcript content unexpectedly.

checks.name: Latency and throughput regression
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: Performance-critical path changes
checks.evidence: Protected baseline, representative workload, repetitions, p50/p95/p99 and host conditions. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Measured distribution and throughput satisfy the accepted comparison and absolute budget.
checks.failCriterion: A reproducible controlled result breaches an accepted budget beyond its tolerance.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: One timing or incomparable hardware is inconclusive; disclose sampling uncertainty
checks.validation: conforming - Comparable repeated runs meet p95 target; violating - same workload consistently breaches it.

checks.name: Peak memory and retained growth
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: Allocation-heavy or long-lived code changes
checks.evidence: Process-tree RSS, managed/native heap where available, workload phases and soak profile. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Peak and post-cycle retained memory meet accepted budgets.
checks.failCriterion: Reproducible peak or retained-growth behavior exceeds the accepted contract.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Caches, allocator retention, mapped space and GC timing are not automatically leaks
checks.validation: conforming - Steady-state reuse stays bounded; violating - retained objects grow across identical completed cycles.

checks.name: Allocation and copy amplification
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: Hot paths, object mapping or serialization changes
checks.evidence: Allocation count/bytes, copy profile and representative input sizes. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Measured allocation/copy cost stays within the accepted budget.
checks.failCriterion: A reproducible changed path exceeds the allocation/copy budget.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Source-level copy counts can differ from optimized runtime behavior
checks.validation: conforming - Borrowed slices meet budget; violating - repeated full-payload copies breach it.

checks.name: Resource lifetime and cleanup
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: File, socket, subscription, process or connection ownership changes
checks.evidence: Resource counters before/after repeated operations, cancellation and error paths. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Resources return to the allowed steady-state range after all required paths.
checks.failCriterion: A repeatable path leaks handles, children or connections beyond the accepted range.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Pooling may intentionally retain resources within an explicit bound
checks.validation: conforming - Cancelled request releases connection; violating - each cancellation leaves one child process alive.

checks.name: Query count, N+1 and execution plans
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: Database access or list rendering changes
checks.evidence: Per-operation query counts, representative rows, plan statistics and accepted query budget. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Query count and measured plan cost meet the workload budget.
checks.failCriterion: A reproduced operation exceeds the allowed query/resource cost.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: EXPLAIN ANALYZE executes SQL; use a disposable database for mutating statements
checks.validation: conforming - List query count remains bounded; violating - one extra query appears for every row.

checks.name: Event-loop or UI-thread blocking
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: Synchronous work enters interactive or async paths
checks.evidence: Responsiveness traces, long-task spans and accepted interaction budget. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Observed blocking remains below the accepted limit during the declared workload.
checks.failCriterion: A reproducible blocking interval breaks the interaction budget.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Short synthetic runs can miss large-payload stalls
checks.validation: conforming - Large import keeps UI responsive; violating - synchronous parse freezes interactions.

checks.name: Backpressure and admission control
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: Producer/consumer, upload or job scheduling changes
checks.evidence: Rate/load experiment, queue metrics and accepted overload policy. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Excess work is bounded, deferred or rejected according to contract.
checks.failCriterion: Overload causes unbounded growth or forbidden loss/acceptance.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: A nominal request-rate limit does not prove downstream capacity control
checks.validation: conforming - Queue saturates and rejects predictably; violating - accepted backlog grows until out of memory.

checks.name: Cancellation, timeout and retry budgets
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: Long operations or retries change
checks.evidence: Deadline policy, cancellation propagation and process/network traces. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Work stops or unwinds within the accepted limits and retry budget.
checks.failCriterion: Cancelled or expired work continues consuming resources beyond the contract.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Some external actions are non-cancellable; surface that limitation explicitly
checks.validation: conforming - Cancellation reaches child process; violating - parent stops but child continues indefinitely.

checks.name: Payload, bundle and artifact growth
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: Dependencies, assets, generated files or packaging change
checks.evidence: Reachable bundle composition, compressed/uncompressed sizes and accepted size budget. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Required artifacts stay within the agreed size and loading budget.
checks.failCriterion: A measured artifact exceeds its accepted size/loading budget.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Source whitespace is not automatically shipped or a meaningful runtime cost
checks.validation: conforming - Tree-shaken build stays within budget; violating - unused SDK dominates delivered bundle.

checks.name: Cache correctness and bounded benefit
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: Cache keys, invalidation, TTL or capacity changes
checks.evidence: Key policy, cold/warm traces, invalidation probes and memory/hit metrics. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Cache preserves accepted semantics and resource limits in tested scenarios.
checks.failCriterion: Stale, cross-user or incorrectly keyed data violates the contract, or bounds fail.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: A high hit rate does not establish correctness or net benefit
checks.validation: conforming - Tenant-aware cache invalidates on write; violating - tenant omitted from cache key.

checks.name: Data races and unsafe interleavings
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: Concurrent shared-state or synchronization changes
checks.evidence: Instrumented race report or bounded model trace and accepted invariant. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: No violation appears in the declared instrumented campaign.
checks.failCriterion: A reproducible race or explored interleaving violates the accepted invariant.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Uninstrumented operations and unexplored schedules remain uncovered
checks.validation: conforming - Instrumented lock protects state; violating - controlled interleaving loses a write.

checks.name: Deadlock, starvation and lock contention
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: Lock ordering or shared resource acquisition changes
checks.evidence: Acquisition graph, bounded contention run and liveness budget. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Operations make required progress under the tested contention model.
checks.failCriterion: A reproducible cycle or starvation exceeds the accepted progress limit.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Timeout can indicate slow infrastructure rather than a proven deadlock
checks.validation: conforming - Stable lock order completes; violating - opposing lock order reproduces a cycle.

checks.name: Retry storms and circuit behavior
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: Retry policy or dependency protection changes
checks.evidence: Failure injection, attempt counts, jitter/backoff settings and recovery trace. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Retry traffic and recovery stay within the accepted policy.
checks.failCriterion: Failure amplification or retry volume breaches the accepted limit.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Retries are not inherently wrong; classify idempotency and recovery together
checks.validation: conforming - Outage produces bounded attempts; violating - every layer multiplies retries.

checks.name: Partial failure and compensating actions
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory

checks.passCriterion: Each tested partial failure reaches an accepted terminal or recoverable state.
checks.failCriterion: A tested failure leaves an unreconciled state prohibited by the contract.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Compensation itself can fail and requires its own observable status
checks.validation: conforming - Reservation released after payment failure; violating - reservation remains permanently stranded.

checks.name: Duplicate, reordered and delayed events
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: Event-driven state machine changes
checks.evidence: Delivery permutations, version/sequence metadata and invariant assertions. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: State remains valid under the declared delivery guarantees.
checks.failCriterion: A allowed delivery order or delay produces a forbidden state.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Do not assume exactly-once ordered delivery without a real contract
checks.validation: conforming - Older update ignored by version; violating - delayed old event overwrites newer state.

checks.name: Crash consistency and atomic file updates
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory

checks.evidence: Controlled interruption points, fsync/rename policy and restart reads. Also require the common evidence contract.

checks.failCriterion: Crash or competing writer exposes a torn or forbidden lost state.

checks.name: Graceful shutdown and drain

checks.evidence: Signal trace, in-flight work accounting and post-restart state. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Shutdown meets the accepted drain/cancel/recovery contract.
checks.failCriterion: Accepted work disappears or resources persist outside that contract.

checks.validation: conforming - Inflight task drains or resumes; violating - shutdown acknowledges then loses it.

checks.name: Recovery after collector or tool failure
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: Agent runtime, watcher or verifier crashes/restarts
checks.evidence: Checkpoint, worktree state, run IDs, reconnect handshake and replay ledger. Also require the common evidence contract.
