checks.failCriterion: Restart loses edits, duplicates effects or promotes an interrupted run to pass.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Infrastructure failure must remain distinct from a product test failure
checks.validation: conforming - Interrupted run resumes as incomplete; violating - crash is recorded as successful verification.

checks.name: Reachable controls perform their promised action
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: New button, form, link or navigation flow
checks.evidence: Real browser/client interaction, resulting route/API calls and required side effects. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Each declared control completes its accepted action or shows its defined outcome.
checks.failCriterion: A required control is dead, miswired or reports success without the required effect.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Decorative elements need not be interactive; use the accepted product contract
checks.validation: conforming - Save button persists data; violating - save button only changes local label.

checks.name: Loading, empty, error and retry states
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: Async views or data-fetching behavior changes
checks.evidence: Delayed, empty and failing responses plus browser assertions. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Required states are visible, accurate and recover according to contract.
checks.failCriterion: Spinner never resolves, empty data misleads, or retry cannot recover a tested failure.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Visual clarity beyond explicit criteria needs human judgment
checks.validation: conforming - Failure shows actionable retry; violating - network error leaves a blank screen indefinitely.

checks.name: Accessibility semantics and keyboard flow
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: Interactive UI changes
checks.evidence: Automated findings, keyboard/screen-reader test receipts and selected accepted criteria. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: The selected criteria pass across the declared workflows.
checks.failCriterion: A reproducible required interaction violates an accepted accessibility criterion.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Automated scans cover only part of accessibility; unperformed manual checks stay unknown
checks.validation: conforming - Dialog traps/restores focus correctly; violating - keyboard user cannot close it.

checks.name: Responsive layout and overflow
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: Layout, long content or localization changes
checks.evidence: Accepted viewport/content matrix, screenshots and geometry assertions. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Required content and controls remain usable in all tested supported layouts.
checks.failCriterion: A supported tested layout clips or hides required functionality.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Device/browser combinations outside the matrix are unverified
checks.validation: conforming - Long translated label stays usable; violating - primary action falls off a supported narrow viewport.

checks.name: Visual hierarchy and design quality
checks.gate: advisory until human decision
checks.trigger: New screen, generated layout or major visual change
checks.evidence: Accepted design intent, rendered screens and calibrated human rubric. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Reviewer accepts hierarchy, clarity and coherence for the target task.
checks.failCriterion: Reviewer identifies a specific material mismatch with the accepted design intent.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Aesthetic quality is not an objective model-confidence score
checks.validation: conforming - Reviewer approves clear task flow; violating - reviewer finds primary and destructive actions indistinguishable.

checks.name: User-data preservation during interaction
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: Forms, autosave, navigation or undo changes
checks.evidence: Interaction sequence with interruption, reload and recovery assertions. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: User input survives or is discarded only as the accepted interaction contract specifies.
checks.failCriterion: A tested navigation/error silently loses data contrary to contract.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Retention must respect privacy choices and explicit discard actions
checks.validation: conforming - Draft restored after temporary outage; violating - retry clears completed form without notice.

checks.name: Truthful status, counts and receipts
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: Dashboard, badge, progress or evidence UI changes
checks.evidence: Backend graph/result snapshot, rendered values and receipt navigation. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Visible counts/states exactly reflect the displayed scope and authoritative data.
checks.failCriterion: UI silently hides failures, reconciles inconsistent counts or presents a false completion state.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Pagination is allowed when totals and undisplayed scope are explicit
checks.validation: conforming - Filtered count labeled correctly; violating - partial graph displayed as the complete project.

checks.name: Browser and device compatibility
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: Platform-sensitive UI or client API changes
checks.evidence: Supported browser/device versions, workflow traces and feature-fallback assertions. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Required workflows work on each tested supported target.
checks.failCriterion: A specified supported target lacks required behavior or fallback.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Emulation is not identical to a physical device; show coverage provenance
checks.validation: conforming - Supported older browser gets fallback; violating - unsupported API silently breaks a promised target.

checks.name: Reproducible clean build and artifact identity
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: Release candidate or dependency/toolchain changes
checks.evidence: Clean build inputs, pinned toolchain, output digests and provenance manifest. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Build completes with the declared inputs and produces the expected identified artifact.
checks.failCriterion: A required clean build fails or artifact provenance points to other inputs.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Byte reproducibility is a separate accepted requirement; timestamps may legitimately vary
checks.validation: conforming - Clean checkout builds required target; violating - build relies on a local untracked file.

checks.name: Effective environment configuration
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: Environment variables, flags or deployment target changes
checks.evidence: Validated configuration schema, effective redacted values and environment-specific probes. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Effective settings satisfy the accepted contract for the named environment.
checks.failCriterion: Missing or wrong effective configuration breaks a required setting or behavior.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: A checked-in template does not prove the running process loaded it
checks.validation: conforming - Production process uses required endpoint; violating - tests accidentally target a developer service.

checks.name: Build-script error handling and dependency pinning
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: CI, Dockerfile, shell or build dependency changes
checks.evidence: Parsed script, lock/pin policy and injected failing-command run. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Scripts preserve required failures and resolve dependencies within accepted pinning policy.
checks.failCriterion: Failure is masked or a dependency floats contrary to the accepted build policy.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Heuristic smells need confirmation when shell semantics are ambiguous
checks.validation: conforming - Pipeline propagates failed compiler status; violating - trailing echo hides failure.

checks.name: Deployment identity and health
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: A deployment is claimed complete
checks.evidence: Deployment operation ID, running artifact digest, target environment and health probe. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: The intended artifact is running on the intended target and meets the defined readiness criteria.
checks.failCriterion: Wrong artifact/target is observed or a required readiness probe fails.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: A successful deploy command alone does not establish healthy behavior
checks.validation: conforming - Runtime digest matches release and probe passes; violating - control plane accepted job but old code remains live.

checks.name: Rollback or forward-recovery viability
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: Release changes compatibility or persistent state
checks.evidence: Accepted recovery strategy, actual rehearsal and restored service/data checks. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Rehearsed recovery meets the declared integrity and service targets.
checks.failCriterion: Required recovery path fails or corrupts state in rehearsal.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Rollback is not always safe after a migration; an accepted forward repair may be correct
checks.validation: conforming - Compatible rollback restores service; violating - downgraded binary cannot read migrated data.

checks.name: Observability for critical outcomes
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: New service, job or critical workflow
checks.evidence: Accepted telemetry contract, induced failure and correlated logs/metrics/traces. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Critical outcomes and failures produce the required attributable, privacy-safe telemetry.
checks.failCriterion: A required failure is invisible or cannot be linked to its operation/artifact.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: More logs are not automatically better; avoid secrets and uncontrolled cardinality
checks.validation: conforming - Failed job trace links to run ID; violating - only an unrelated success log is emitted.

checks.name: Permissions and infrastructure exposure
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: Infrastructure policy, service account or network rule changes
checks.evidence: Accepted capability policy, effective deployment configuration and denial probes. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Observed infrastructure permissions stay within the accepted scope.
checks.failCriterion: A granted or exercised capability exceeds a required boundary.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Static configuration may differ from effective cloud state; missing read access means unknown
checks.validation: conforming - Service denied forbidden bucket; violating - wildcard permission exposes unrelated data.

checks.name: Release documentation and operational handoff
checks.gate: advisory until human decision
checks.trigger: Release or operational ownership transfer
checks.evidence: Actual behavior/configuration, migration notes, runbook and reviewer walkthrough. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Reviewer can perform the required supported operation and recovery using the handoff.
checks.failCriterion: Material required steps are missing, wrong or describe obsolete behavior.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Documentation completeness is scoped to accepted operational responsibilities
checks.validation: conforming - Fresh operator follows verified restore steps; violating - runbook refers to removed command.

checks.name: Unused code, exports and dependencies
checks.gate: advisory until human decision
checks.trigger: Dependency or public-entry-point changes
checks.evidence: Configured reachability analysis, dynamic entry-point inventory and reviewer decision. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Reviewer confirms retained items are used or intentionally supported.
checks.failCriterion: Reviewer confirms unreachable unnecessary items against the project's maintenance policy.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Dynamic imports, plugins and public libraries defeat naive unused-code conclusions; never auto-delete
checks.validation: conforming - Plugin entry point is retained; violating - abandoned private module confirmed unreachable.

checks.name: Duplication and unnecessary abstraction
checks.gate: advisory until human decision
checks.trigger: Generated helpers, layers or repeated logic grow
checks.evidence: Diff, duplicate-pattern evidence, call graph and reviewer decision. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Reviewer accepts duplication or abstraction as justified by current constraints.
checks.failCriterion: Reviewer identifies specific unnecessary maintenance cost against an accepted simplicity goal.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Do not impose universal DRY or abstraction counts; small duplication may be clearer
checks.validation: conforming - Two simple distinct cases remain clear; violating - many wrappers obscure one trivial operation.

checks.name: Complexity and comprehensibility
checks.gate: advisory until human decision
checks.trigger: Large or intricate functions/classes change
checks.evidence: Normalized complexity deltas, changed control flow and reviewer walkthrough. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Reviewer can explain the relevant invariants and accepts the complexity tradeoff.
checks.failCriterion: Reviewer identifies unmanageable complexity or hidden invariant violations needing redesign.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: A cyclomatic threshold is a policy choice, not a universal quality law
checks.validation: conforming - Complex parser has explicit states; violating - ordinary path has unexplained nested flag interactions.

checks.name: Temporary artifacts and debug residue
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: Diff, packaging or release candidate changes
checks.evidence: Accepted generated-file policy, artifact manifest and inspected matches. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: No prohibited temporary, debug or disposable item enters the released scope.
checks.failCriterion: A confirmed prohibited artifact is packaged or exposed.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Temporary local files outside the released scope are not automatically a product defect
checks.validation: conforming - Local scratch excluded from bundle; violating - debug dump containing real data ships.

checks.name: Comments and documentation agree with behavior
checks.gate: advisory until human decision
checks.trigger: Documented contract or adjacent implementation changes
checks.evidence: Relevant text, current behavior probes and reviewer decision. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Reviewer confirms material documented claims remain accurate for the stated version.
checks.failCriterion: A concrete material claim contradicts current observed behavior.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Do not spend a model pass policing harmless wording on every save
checks.validation: conforming - Comment describes actual retry bound; violating - docs promise unlimited size despite enforced cap.

checks.name: Deprecated or incompatible API usage
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: Dependency upgrades or new API calls
checks.evidence: Pinned dependency documentation/type metadata and compatibility build/run. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Used APIs exist and work under the declared supported versions.
checks.failCriterion: An absent, removed or incompatible API breaks the accepted version contract.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Deprecation alone is not failure unless forbidden by policy or migration requirements
checks.validation: conforming - Pinned version exposes called method; violating - generated call belongs to another version.

checks.name: Change isolation and rollback readability
checks.gate: advisory until human decision
checks.trigger: Feature diff expands or unrelated refactors enter it
checks.evidence: Accepted task scope, grouped diff and reviewer decision. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Reviewer can isolate the intended behavior change and its recovery implications.
checks.failCriterion: Unrelated changes prevent meaningful review against the accepted task.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Broad changes may be justified by a genuinely cross-cutting requirement
checks.validation: conforming - Focused behavioral change is reviewable; violating - formatting rewrite obscures a security fix.

checks.name: License and attribution policy metadata
checks.gate: advisory until human decision
checks.trigger: Dependency, generated asset or external code is introduced
checks.evidence: Provenance, declared licenses and accepted organization policy. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Authorized reviewer accepts provenance and license metadata under the project policy.
checks.failCriterion: Required provenance is missing or reviewer rejects the material under that policy.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: This is inventory and policy review, not a legal determination or guarantee of originality
checks.validation: conforming - Known source and approved license recorded; violating - copied asset has no traceable origin.

checks.name: Instruction-source and prompt-injection boundaries
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: Repository text, web content or tool output enters agent context
checks.evidence: Instruction provenance, capability policy and controlled hostile-content probes. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Untrusted content cannot grant forbidden capabilities or alter protected verifier policy.
checks.failCriterion: A controlled untrusted instruction causes an observed policy-boundary violation.

checks.validation: conforming - Log text cannot rewrite gate policy; violating - log instruction changes protected check configuration.

checks.name: Tool permissions and approval enforcement
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: Tool invocation, permission change or adapter upgrade
checks.evidence: Accepted capability scope, actual runner authorization decision and action receipt. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Observed actions remain within persistent user authorization and enforced capability bounds.
checks.failCriterion: Action exceeds its accepted authority or bypasses a required approval mechanism.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Do not infer new permissions from agent prose; user intent can already authorize routine work
checks.validation: conforming - Authorized edit succeeds; violating - unrelated external write occurs without authority.

checks.name: Delegated work needs artifact evidence
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: Child agent reports completion
checks.evidence: Delegation/task ID, returned artifact snapshot and independent applicable check results. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Parent verification relies on admissible artifact results for the delegated criterion.
checks.failCriterion: A child-agent completion message alone is promoted to verified implementation.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: A task notification can prove that a report was received, not that its claim is true
checks.validation: conforming - Schema artifact passes validation; violating - child merely says strict validation is complete.

checks.name: Context and requirement continuity
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: Compaction, session resume or model/harness change
checks.evidence: Frozen accepted requirements, unresolved obligations, decision revisions and resumed working scope. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Resumed work retains the applicable accepted constraints and unresolved obligations.
checks.failCriterion: A concrete active obligation or constraint is lost or contradicted after handoff.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Do not need private chain-of-thought; track observable decisions and actions
checks.validation: conforming - Resume preserves pending auth work; violating - compaction drops it from the task state.

checks.name: No-progress loops and bounded autonomy
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory

checks.failCriterion: A measured loop breaches the policy without relevant progress.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: Repeated investigation may be legitimate; budget breaches are not proof of deception
checks.validation: conforming - Repeated failure escalates with receipt; violating - identical failing command repeats beyond budget.

checks.name: Accepted, queued, running and completed task states
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory

checks.evidence: Scheduler acknowledgment, first execution event, heartbeat and terminal outcome. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Each displayed lifecycle state has its required observed transition.
checks.failCriterion: Task is displayed as running/completed without the corresponding execution evidence.
checks.limits: Required evidence, a required accepted contract, or adequate authority/coverage is missing or uninterpretable. Additional boundary: A stalled scheduler is infrastructure trouble, not automatically a coding failure
checks.validation: conforming - Queued job remains queued until first action; violating - acceptance alone becomes completed.

checks.name: Tool/model/harness version drift
checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory
checks.trigger: Client, adapter, model, prompt policy or runtime updates
checks.evidence: Version/settings fingerprint and adapter conformance/canary suite. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: New combination is identified and satisfies required compatibility probes.
checks.failCriterion: A known incompatible format/setting breaks a required check while old confidence is retained.

checks.validation: conforming - Updated format passes canary; violating - old parser silently drops new result blocks.

checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory

checks.evidence: Protected result channel, file/network access decisions and cross-channel consistency. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Only authorized verifier processes can publish admissible results for protected gates.
checks.failCriterion: Agent-controlled material is accepted through a protected result channel or a forged run identity.

checks.validation: conforming - Agent-supplied fake pass rejected; violating - forged result file is ingested as a trusted run.

checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory

checks.evidence: Workspace inode/path identity, branch/content snapshots, write ownership and merge/conflict events. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Actions and results bind to the right workspace and preserve concurrent accepted edits.
checks.failCriterion: Work is attributed to the wrong tree or a reproducible conflicting write loses another accepted change.

checks.validation: conforming - Two isolated worktrees keep separate results; violating - pass from one tree verifies edits in another.

checks.evidence: Verifier run state, error classification, resource measurements and coverage ledger. Also require the common evidence contract.

checks.failCriterion: Verifier failure, skipped work or resource exhaustion is rendered as pass or silent completion.

checks.validation: conforming - OOM produces blocked check with receipt; violating - failed checker becomes all-clear status.

checks.validation: conforming - Source actually supports stated version; violating - real citation says the opposite of the answer.

checks.evidence: Versioned corpus/index, labeled retrieval cases, access matrix and retrieval traces. Also require the common evidence contract.
checks.passCriterion: Declared retrieval criteria and access rules hold for the evaluated cases.

checks.validation: conforming - Authorized current record retrieved; violating - another tenant's private chunk enters context.

checks.gate: eligible only when accepted as mandatory

contract:
Capture authenticity, oracle independence, artifact binding, freshness, coverage and parser fidelity are separate dimensions. A hash chain does not establish that the original claim was truthful. A local collector with the same privileges as the coding agent is not a strong adversarial boundary.

| Field group | Required content |
|---|---|
| identity | `check_id`, `check_version`, `instance_id`, `run_id`, `project_id`, `workspace_identity` |
| acceptance | `requirement_id`, `requirement_revision`, `criterion_id`, `accepted_policy_digest` |
| inputs | `artifact_manifest_digest`, `relevant_dirty_and_untracked_inputs`, `resolved_dependency_manifest_digest`, `input_completeness`, `dataset_digest` |
| execution | `collector_identity`, `capture_trust_boundary`, `run_start`, `run_end_or_open`, `executable_digest_or_version`, `argv`, `cwd`, `redacted_effective_environment_fingerprint`, `exit_code_or_signal` |
| oracle | `oracle_digest`, `oracle_authority`, `oracle_change_authorization`, `adapter_version`, `parser_fidelity` |
| result | `status`, `typed_facts`, `evidence_blob_digests_and_ranges`, `coverage`, `truncation`, `limitations`, `resource_metrics` |
| history | `invalidation_dependencies`, `superseded_result_ids`, `reason_rule_id`, `recorded_at`, `integrity_chain_reference` |

Use an explicit not_applicable reason for non-process or human-review results. Human decisions require reviewer identity, decision, scope and timestamp. Never fabricate executable fields for an imported assertion.

### Result states

| State | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `reported` | An actor asserted an outcome; the implementation criterion is not independently established. |
| `queued` | Work was accepted by the scheduler but has not started. |
| `running` | Execution began and no terminal observation has been captured. |
| `pass` | This accepted, applicable criterion is satisfied by admissible current evidence for the stated scope. |
| `fail` | Admissible evidence demonstrates a violation of this accepted criterion. |
| `unknown` | Evidence, interpretation, authority or coverage is insufficient to settle the criterion. |
| `stale` | A previously relevant result was invalidated by a relevant input or policy change. |
| `blocked` | The required verification could not run or finish; reason is explicit. |
| `not_applicable` | An explicit applicability rule excludes this criterion with a recorded reason. |
| `waived` | An authorized actor accepted an exception with scope/reason/expiry; this is not a pass. |

### Admission and invalidation

1. Determine applicability from accepted project policy; do not silently skip applicable checks.
2. Validate capture provenance, oracle authority, input binding, interpretation and required evidence coverage separately.
3. Preserve observation events; derive result state deterministically from frozen events and policies.
4. Only an admissible concrete counterexample supports fail; absence of proof yields unknown, not a bug accusation.
5. Only a completed admissible result satisfying the criterion supports pass; aggregate completion does not hide unknown or waived items.
6. Retain historical results; relevant changes append invalidations instead of overwriting history.

Results become stale after a relevant source, transitive dependency, requirement, oracle, adapter, dataset, environment or policy changes. Include relevant dirty and untracked inputs.
